summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
summary_short.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…

summary_short.zh: n8n-mcp 是一个 Model Context Protocol 服务器，它让 Claude 等 AI 助手能够通过自然语言指令创建 n8n 工作流，从而将对话式 AI 与自动化流程连接起来。该项目通过将 n8n 的工作流构建功能封装为 MCP 工具，使大型语言模型能够以编程方式调用这些功能，展示了协议化接口如何让复杂系统对 AI 代理变得可访问。开发者可以将其集成到 Claude Desktop 等兼容 MCP 的工具中，用自然语言快速生成自动化流程，或者通过添加自定义 n8n 节点作为新的 MCP 工具来扩展其功能，实现更专业的自动化场景。
summary_short.en: n8n-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI assistants like Claude to create n8n workflows through natural language commands, bridging conversational AI with workflow automation. It works by exposing n8n's workflow-building capabilities as MCP tools that AI agents…
summary_short.es: n8n-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI assistants like Claude to create n8n workflows through natural language commands, bridging conversational AI with workflow automation. It works by exposing n8n's workflow-building capabilities as MCP tools that AI agents…

summary_short.zh: TaskExplorer是一款功能强大的Windows任务管理器，它通过可视化进程树、DLL依赖关系和网络连接，帮助用户深入理解系统运行机制并识别异常行为。该项目采用C语言开发，其核心设计在于将分散的系统信息整合到统一界面中，直观展示应用程序如何与操作系统交互，这种架构为分析复杂软件行为提供了清晰视角。安全研究人员可用它追踪恶意软件驻留技术，开发者能调试程序依赖问题，普通用户也可学习系统工作原理，通过实时监控探索Windows底层机制。
summary_short.en: TaskExplorer is a powerful Windows task manager that provides deep visibility into system processes and their relationships, helping users identify suspicious activities and understand complex software interactions. Its technical strength lies in visualizing process trees, DLL d…

summary_short.zh: Blender-MCP是一个开源工具，通过模型上下文协议将Blender的3D建模功能与AI智能体连接起来，实现自动化3D场景操作。其技术核心是将Blender的Python API封装为结构化端点，使AI系统能够可靠调用各种3D操作，将复杂的建模任务转化为可编程函数。开发者可将其集成到AI工作流中，用于程序化生成场景、修改物体或创建动画，为自动化内容创作提供了新的可能性。该项目展示了如何通过标准化接口让传统专业软件与新兴AI系统协同工作。
summary_short.en: Blender-MCP is an open-source tool that bridges Blender's 3D modeling capabilities with AI agents through the Model Context Protocol, enabling automated 3D scene manipulation. Its technical innovation lies in exposing Blender's Python API as structured endpoints that AI systems …
summary_short.es: Blender-MCP is an open-source tool that bridges Blender's 3D modeling capabilities with AI agents through the Model Context Protocol, enabling automated 3D scene manipulation. Its technical innovation lies in exposing Blender's Python API as structured endpoints that AI systems …
